agent_explanation: With controller disabled (work 0) and no walls, energy falls from ~8589 to ~4611 by step 30, then a body-body collision during step 31 (bodies converge to near-contact, substeps 26) jumps energy to ~21350, exceeding allowed ~9452. The restitution impulse/positional correction for the fast oblique impact between light (m=1, e=0.9) and heavy (m=15.34, e=0.7) bodies injects energy instead of dissipating it. Removing restitution (e=0) eliminates the violation.
